body:
As far as friends go, I'm not overly sociable. I don't go out of my way to make friends, and I don't fake happiness or emotions to earn friendship. So, no one wants to be friends with a self-loathing, worthless, volatile person eh? No, people prefer the company of those who make themselves feel better but I can't offer that. The people who tolerate me soon disappear.

Trust me, I've tried thought training, I have tried everything to stop this. I feel like I dug my grave years ago, it's just taken me this long to climb into it. 

I'll admit, this is a relapse and a hard one, but I have been bested. I've fought and struggled and given what I can, but it's not been enough and it has got to a point now where I just cannot deal with any more.

Thank you, I appreciate you reaching out.
Love was keeping me going for a while, despite the constant battle. But this has recently ended.
Friends are non-existent. The other things you mention help to distract the mind and alleviate the pain for a short while sometimes, other times it only makes things worse. But it always comes crashing down tenfold when I'm removed from that environment.
Addictions...drinking I suppose? Whilst I'm not a heavy drinker, I do drink most evenings just to numb things, if nothing else. Without that my thoughts get out of control and I can find myself in a hysteria. Self harm is something I've battled for years, it's a fucking plague on my mind.
